reason: I'd probably start the free 5 weeks in a burst of motivation, but 45 minutes a day while back at work with a baby won't last, and I'd drop off long before I'd need to pay for the 8-week program. Plus there are free postpartum workouts on YouTube if I get keen again.
objection: 45 minutes every day is unrealistic for me. I know I'll stop the moment sleep or the baby's routine changes, so why pay for more of something I won't finish.
would_change_my_mind: Shorter 15-20 minute sessions I could do after 6pm when my partner is home, plus a physio's backing on the pelvic floor and diastasis work so it feels safer than random YouTube videos.
